name: Kyuukon Saimin ~Watashi, Zettai ni Uwaki Nante Shimasen~
original_name: 求婚催眠 ～私、絶対に浮気なんてしません～
source:
The protagonist, Hachiyama Saisei, was a man who had clawed his way up from the very bottom. He let nothing stand in his way, using deception, threats, and hypnotic techniques as needed to expand his company.

His next target was the Sakuragaoka Group. After infiltrating one of their parties, Saisei found himself utterly captivated by the beauty of Sakuragaoka Rei - a woman young enough to be his daughter. He was already scheming to absorb the Sakuragaoka Group and grow his own enterprise even further. From his perspective, a politically arranged marriage with Reisen was the optimal choice, satisfying both his ambitions and his desires.

Yet the Sakuragaoka family dismissed him outright, and Rei already had a fiancé. The Sakuragaoka Group stood on a level far above the company Saisei owned; neither power, nor money, nor threats would move them. Undeterred, he secured a position on the board of directors for the academy Rei attended and approached her with a wager. He would employ his specialty - hypnotic suggestion - upon her for roughly one month. If, at the end of that period, her feelings for the fiancé remained unchanged, he would abandon all his schemes and withdraw completely.

Rei placed no belief whatsoever in such a thing as hypnosis. Still, for the sake of her family and her boyfriend, she accepted the terms Saisei laid before her.

[Translated from the [url=http://crossover-game.jp/include/kyukonsaimin/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公八山斋生是一个从底层爬上来的人。他不让任何事情阻碍他，根据需要使用欺骗、威胁和催眠技术来扩大他的公司。

他的下一个目标是樱丘集团。混入他们的一个派对后，齐成发现自己完全被樱丘丽的美丽迷住了——一个年轻得可以成为他女儿的女人。他已经盘算着要吸收樱丘集团，进一步发展自己的企业。在他看来，与雷森的政治包办婚姻是最佳选择，既满足了他的野心，也满足了他的欲望。

然而樱丘家却断然解雇了他，丽已经有了未婚夫。樱丘集团的地位远远高于Saisei拥有的公司；无论是权力、金钱还是威胁都无法打动他们。他没有被吓倒，他在丽就读的学院获得了董事会职位，并向她打赌。他会对她使用他的专长——催眠暗示——大约一个月。如果到了这段时间，她对未婚夫的感情依然没有改变，他就会放弃一切计划，彻底退出。

丽根本不相信催眠这种东西。尽管如此，为了家人和男朋友，她还是接受了斋成提出的条件。

[翻译自[url=http://crossover-game.jp/include/kyukonsaimin/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
